title: Seat Sales Channel Rates — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Channel pricing — advance seats on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The seat price of an advance seat is multiplied by the **channel rate**, which follows the channel the seat was paid through, as recorded on the latest seat charge of the segment. The rate acts on the seat price before it is rounded to the cent.

| Channel the seat was paid through | Channel rate |
|---|---|
| Online | 0.95 |
| At the airport | 1.15 |
| Through the call center | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical seat price of 40 dollars)

| Channel | Price after the channel rate |
|---|---|
| Online | 38.00 |
| Airport | 46.00 |
| Call center | 40.00 |

An airport rate above one raises the seat price; an online rate below one lowers it.
